4c101ae6389d3ed0bcbdce3c9260ce54.overview: A teenage cartoonist rejects the comforts of his suburban life in a misguided quest for soul.
4c101ae6389d3ed0bcbdce3c9260ce54.tagline: The story of New Jersey's next great comic book artist and biggest dick.

4c2b5297eea8c162464fd0abc949c131.overview: A series of events unfold like a chain reaction, all stemming from a minor event that brings the film's five characters together. Set in Paris, France, Anne is an actress whose boyfriend Georges photographs the war in Kosovo. Georges' brother, Jean, is looking for the entry code to Georges' apartment. These characters' lives interconnect with a Romanian immigrant and a deaf teacher.
4c2b5297eea8c162464fd0abc949c131.tagline: Love has a language all its own.

4c42a2e212fe18d56b9f93b919a65932.overview: A curmudgeonly instructor at a New England prep school is forced to remain on campus during Christmas break to babysit the handful of students with nowhere to go. Eventually, he forms an unlikely bond with one of them — a damaged, brainy troublemaker — and with the school’s head cook, who has just lost a son in Vietnam.

4c534342a738481fa28e15d34f1fb5a8.overview: Lady Snowblood is caught by the police and sentenced to death for her crimes. As she is sent to the gallows she is rescued by the secret police who offer her a deal to assassinate some revolutionaries.
4c534342a738481fa28e15d34f1fb5a8.tagline: Born in prison on a snowy night, she's on an endless journey of carnage

4c64bb2458e19833532513987b3510e9.overview: Mismatched cousins David and Benji reunite for a tour through Poland to honor their beloved grandmother. The adventure takes a turn when the pair's old tensions resurface against the backdrop of their family history.

4c6b6f23b40bd0a525d5f6db5b5e6b21.overview: Although Jo Jo Dancer has achieved success as a stand-up comedian, he hasn't found happiness. After receiving severe burns in a narcotics-related incident, Jo Jo remains in a coma, and, while in this state, he looks back on his life. Drifting off into memories of his troubled childhood, Jo Jo revisits his youth, recalling his eventual rise to fame and the decadence that followed. As he considers his existence, he must decide if he wants to go on living or not.
4c6b6f23b40bd0a525d5f6db5b5e6b21.tagline: A comic with one eye on his audience and another eye on the truth.

4ccbc6e5158aa305df99da9eec03796a.overview: After a seven-year absence, Charlotte Andergast travels to Sweden to reunite with her daughter Eva. The pair have a troubled relationship: Charlotte sacrificed the responsibilities of motherhood for a career as a classical pianist. Over an emotional night, the pair reopen the wounds of the past. Charlotte gets another shock when she finds out that her mentally impaired daughter, Helena, is out of the asylum and living with Eva.

4cf81e1a814d2c53cc7a0cb6bcf538f4.overview: After a night on the town, Jonathan Blair wakes to find that Texan Valentine Ransome has escorted him home. Valentine is attracted to Jonathan and sets out first to reform him, and his family's near-bankrupt shipping company, and then to marry him. In her way is Jonathan's fiancée, actress Carol Wallace.
4cf81e1a814d2c53cc7a0cb6bcf538f4.tagline: SHE GOT HER MAN WITH A SOCK IN THE EYE!
